study.question: Can a task-specific subset of auxiliary context-embedding gradients recover incumbent click AUC at the already-reduced auxiliary head capacity, and does that architecture actually lower measured prediction cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0037-joint_context_reference reproduced incumbent click AUC0.6671410169523699; reducing all auxiliary heads from(128,64) to(112,64) gave0.6657436780708307. Blocking every auxiliary context gradient gave0.6667604293371615 at BOTH capacities, including identical click Logloss0.18204896106868398. The inherited source blocks auxiliary item/action and scorer-parameter gradients, leaving context embedding gradients as an identified plausible route. This is controlled single-seed support for pathway dependence, not proof of a particular helpful task or broad capacity redundancy. Mechanism hypothesis: some narrowed auxiliary tasks supply useful context updates while others damage the click representation; keeping one task path can recover useful transfer without restoring the removed head channels. It is unverified whether any singleton suffices. Historical embedding/scorer/tower reductions and tied-prefix projection lost quality, whereas residual allocation14/10 and evaluation-only algebraic factoring were more successful. This follow-up does not revive unsupported projection sharing. Narrowed shapes have NOT established a reliable inference-cost reduction; this experiment can provide attribution or fail utility even if AUC recovers. Initial DIN click AUC0.6555440824200336 and imported joint entry0.666753547526167 remain utility references. The incumbent auxiliary AUCs(cart/fav/buy=0.777382/0.784205/0.755347) already trail the adapted DIN reference(0.849070/0.864897/0.870182); optimizing click is not joint improvement across tasks.

study.proposed_difference: Add architecture option auxiliary_context_tasks, a fixed subset of(cart,fav,buy). During training, a nonselected task receives aux_context.detach() before BOTH its residual adapter and direct tower; selected tasks retain the original attached context. Evaluation ignores this ownership switch. Three candidates open cart-only, fav-only or buy-only at the identical reduced capacity. The untouched reference source is a fourth standalone module. Constructor stores a Python tuple and consumes no RNG or trainable state. At identical weights, masks and buffers, this backward gate is forward-identical and preserves each head parameter gradient; it changes only upstream context gradients initially, with subsequent training trajectories free to differ. No broad architectural novelty is claimed. Verification of gradients/equality requires the host, not source inspection alone.
predictions: Primary prospective preservation gate: candidate click AUC must be at least0.6668910169523699(incumbent0.6671410169523699 minus0.00025) AND no more than0.00025 below the fresh reference. Both are required; do not relax to the older entry after results. This also exceeds the imported joint entry minus0.00025. The prior all-block value0.6667604293371615 fails this incumbent gate.

Mechanism screening: a singleton exceeding the empty-subset endpoint0.6667604293371615 by at least0.00025 supports useful transfer from that task only provisionally. A spread >=0.00025 across the three same-capacity subsets supports task dependence in this seed. Smaller differences are inconclusive, not evidence of equality. Do not add singleton AUC effects as if optimization were linear.

Efficiency utility requires the preservation gate, fewer total/dense parameters, at least2% lower measured model-only batch p50 latency AND at least2% lower full-validation inference wall time versus the fresh reference, with p95 no more than2% worse. Hardware/batch/load scope remain matched; report train wall/GPU allocation/peak memory/examples and every task metric regardless. One noisy comparison is screening-only; require repeated matched timings before claiming a saving.

Expected parameter counts: reference total32108245,dense315029,embedding31793216; every candidate total32085877,dense292661,embedding31793216. Removal22368 is7.10% of dense parameters but only0.0697% of total. The context subset adds zero learned parameters and no intended evaluation work. Host must measure actual cost; smaller counts alone cannot pass utility.

At fixed reduced model state, task subsets must give identical four-task forward values in train/eval and identical buffer updates. Per-task backward checks must show context gradient only for permitted task labels, identical click gradients, blocked auxiliary item/scorer gradients and active auxiliary head gradients. Empty subset must match the inherited all-block endpoint and all-three subset the inherited all-open endpoint under copied same-shaped states.

Report full validation click/each-auxiliary AUC and unweighted Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, count2,871,767 with click positives135,500; history slices retain existing bins and counts/positives/negatives. Mark any newly inspected task-by-history differences exploratory. No withheld outcomes requested.
falsifiers: Reject a candidate utility claim on failure of either frozen AUC condition, lack of measured cost reduction, nonfinite predictions/gradients, a wrong validation count or altered mask/information boundary. Recovery of quality alone is an attribution result.

If no singleton improves the all-block endpoint by0.00025, this bounded sparse-path implementation lacks supporting transfer evidence; it does not refute complementary two-task subsets. If matched singleton differences stay below0.00025, task identity is unresolved at screening resolution.

If full-width same-subset controls or paired-seed contrasts remove the apparent benefit, withdraw any provisional capacity/pathway interaction interpretation. If paired cost measurements reverse an apparent saving, reject efficiency even if counts are lower.

If task subsets alter fixed-state forward values/buffers, leak gradients into blocked sources, disable any head/loss, or require forbidden labels/features, treat it as implementation failure rather than scientific counterevidence. Preserve failed costs and receipts.
